pages.title: Changing Form
pages.text: Name your dragon and reach stage three and 300 knowledge to change form. It remains your companion.$(br2)Land and end riding. With empty hands, Shift-right-click and choose Human Form; the equipment and knowledge pages also have this button.

pages.title: Still Your Dragon
pages.text: When the sparks, snowflakes, or lightning fade, the dragon in front of you is still your companion. Its name, age, knowledge, and equipment remain, and it continues to grow.

pages.title: Returning to Dragon Form
pages.text: Before returning to dragon form, find an open space. A doorway that fits a person may not fit open wings.$(br2)If transformation fails, make room and check that the dragon is not riding or being ridden.

pages.title: Transformation and Injury
pages.text: A severely injured dragon cannot learn or transform. Check its health and equipment, then help it reach full health; it will sit and await a command. Read $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury)Wounds and Stone$(/l).
